advancements.cinderflask.cold_and_hollow: Craft an Empty Cinderflask. The gold and glass are the easy part.
advancements.cinderflask.everburn.descri: Seal a living spark inside a Cinderflask, and stop burning a whole coal for a single smelt.
advancements.cinderflask.everburn.title: Everburn
cinderflask.emi.sparking.hint: Right-click a living %s with the Empty Cinderflask.
cinderflask.message.nothing_to_burn: Nothing you are carrying will burn.
cinderflask.tooltip.lore.cold: Gold and blackened steel around cold glass. It holds nothing until something living lends it a spark.
cinderflask.tooltip.lore.lit: The mote inside keeps the embers alive long after a fire would have gone out.
cinderflask.tooltip.lore.unlit: The mote has nothing to feed on. Fill the flask with anything that burns.
